Test trait differences between haplotypes

Source: R/statistics.R
testSNPcombs.Rd

For every haplotype block, all pairs of haplotypes (with at least two phenotyped accessions) are compared with a Welch t-test or a Wilcoxon test (`t_test_method`), and p-values are adjusted with `p_adjust_method`.

Usage

testSNPcombs(comb_sample_Tables, savecopy = TRUE)

Arguments

comb_sample_Tables

The accession table (from [getSNPcombTables()])

savecopy

Save the results (`tables/<trait>_pairwise_tests.csv`) in the output folder

Value

A named list (per block) of data frames with the columns `group1`, `group2`, `n1`, `n2`, `mean1`, `mean2`, `diff`, `statistic`, `df`, `p`, `p.adj`, `p.adj.signif`, `block`, `y.position`, `xmin` and `xmax`. `NULL` if no block could be tested.
